name: 32352 · Quincy, FL
findings: ZIP 32352 (Quincy) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32352 (Quincy) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
